gen-gf-oldenburg-outfit: Commanding letters with low, shallow lowercase and open curve endings lead the way. Outfit follows in cable-like strokes that never swell or thin, and a slightly bigger size than the heading's lowercase would suggest helps it hold up.
gen-gf-oldenburg-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, with curve endings held well apart. Oldenburg is best at showing off a brushy, sign-painted stroke in low lowercase, while the body does its best work as a monoline plain sans with more height.
gen-gf-oldenburg-sora: Precise and geometric, Sora keeps its curves free of any pressure swell. Oldenburg does its best work with a distinctive single-stroke brush look in shallow lowercase, while the sans-serif body is built for moderate height and crisp turns.
gen-gf-oldenburg-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk forms each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe wide open. Oldenburg sits above it with sign-painter brush strokes and shallow lowercase, a lower, rougher-edged partner.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-amulya:
Oxanium opens with a tall, commanding lowercase and monoline strokes.

Amulya settles in beneath it as a plain sans with generous gaps in its curves, a shorter lowercase giving the heading room to stand out.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-chillax: Oxanium lifts its big lowercase and uninterrupted monoline strokes into a distinctive, commanding heading voice. Chillax is the relaxed plain sans, with loose pen-lifted curves.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-plein: Plein feels reliable and clean, with a clear channel leading into each of its round letters. Oxanium's tall rounded-rod lowercase stands over it.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-roundo: Commanding and distinctive, Oxanium makes its lowercase look big. Its best quality is the contrast with Roundo, a geometric sans whose n has matching arch and stem and whose small counters stay unclogged.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-spline-sans: Oxanium's high x-height makes its lowercase look big and its curves end in clear daylight. Spline Sans is the approachable sans underneath, so Oxanium can earn its keep in big, short headings.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-synonym: Tall, bold lowercase with monoline strokes leads here. Synonym follows as a dependable plain sans with a constant stripe of ink and generous curve openings, so Oxanium can earn its keep in big, short headings.
